server.name: io.github.es617/obsidian-sync-mcp
server.description: Give AI agents access to your Obsidian vault via local files or Self-hosted LiveSync.

environmentVariables.description: Path to your Obsidian vault directory (filesystem mode)
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: CouchDB server URL (CouchDB mode)
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_URL

environmentVariables.description: CouchDB username
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_USER

environmentVariables.description: CouchDB password (required in CouchDB mode)
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: CouchDB database name
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_DATABASE

environmentVariables.description: LiveSync E2E encryption passphrase (must match plugin setting)
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_PASSPHRASE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' if 'Obfuscate Properties' is enabled in LiveSync (obfuscates file paths, sizes, dates)
environmentVariables.name: COUCHDB_OBFUSCATE_PROPERTIES

environmentVariables.description: Vault name for deep links and index storage
environmentVariables.name: VAULT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Password for OAuth authentication
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Public URL for OAuth callbacks (required when using a tunnel)
environmentVariables.name: BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP port
environmentVariables.name: PORT

server.name: io.github.es617/serial-mcp-server
server.description: Let AI agents interact with serial devices — list ports, connect, send, and read.

environmentVariables.description: Maximum simultaneous open serial connections (default 10)
environmentVariables.name: SERIAL_MCP_MAX_CONNECTIONS

environmentVariables.description: Plugin policy: 'all' or comma-separated plugin names. Unset = disabled.
environmentVariables.name: SERIAL_MCP_PLUGINS

environmentVariables.description: PTY mirror mode: 'off' (default), 'ro' (read-only), or 'rw' (read-write). macOS/Linux only.
environmentVariables.name: SERIAL_MCP_MIRROR

environmentVariables.description: Base path for PTY symlinks (default /tmp/serial-mcp when mirror is enabled). Connections get numbered: /tmp/serial-mcp0, /tmp/serial-mcp1, etc.
environmentVariables.name: SERIAL_MCP_MIRROR_LINK

environmentVariables.description: Tool name separator character (default '.'). Set to '_' for clients that reject dots (e.g. Cursor).
environmentVariables.name: SERIAL_MCP_TOOL_SEPARATOR
